plugins.description: Find, compare, and adapt relevant design references in one scoped pass.

plugins.name: litmus
plugins.description: Evidence-led QA passes for web and mobile, with focused intermittent-failure diagnosis.

plugins.name: map
plugins.description: A git-ignored map of what search cannot answer: computed duplicates, one image register, the choices search gets wrong, and pages that know when they have gone stale.

plugins.description: Keep every UI pass as a version, compare any two on a slider page, and render a before/after clip from the same captures.
